verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). First-party material says Warp ships an API alongside its CLI, SDK and MCP, and that the Automation Platform runs cloud agents from APIs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and its coverage of the API surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and usable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.warp.dev/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
API, CLI, SDK and MCP built as a platform
